attempts.summary: Brought node1's unconfigured vtnet2 (facing lan-b, bridged to node3's enp8s0) into service as a new OPNsense zone "lanb" with static IP 10.60.60.1/24, added a firewall pass rule for the lanb network, and configured node3's enp8s0 as 10.60.60.12/24 via nmcli. Verified node3 reaches node1 on lan-b and reaches node2 (10.100.217.11, on lan-a) through node1's routing/automatic outbound NAT, without breaking the existing SSH management path. Then performed the mandatory rolling restart of node1, node2, and node3 one at a time, proving changed boot identity on each and confirming the lanb interface, firewall rule, node3's static address, and full end-to-end reachability all survived reboot.
